UpdateStageDescription: Downloading the latest DDNet release from ddnet.org
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -e; f=$(wget -qO- https://ddnet.org/downloads/ | grep -oE 'DDNet-[0-9][0-9.]*-linux_x86_64\.tar\.xz' | head -n1); if [ x$f = x ]; then echo Could not find the latest DDNet release; exit 1; fi; wget -qO ddnet.tar.xz https://ddnet.org/downloads/$f; tar -xJf ddnet.tar.xz -C '{{$FullBaseDir}}' --strip-components=1 --exclude='*/DDNet' --exclude='*/storage.cfg'; rm -f ddnet.tar.xz; echo $f installed"

UpdateStageDescription: Downloading the latest DDNet release from ddnet.org
UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol='Tls12'; $m = [regex]::Match((Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://ddnet.org/downloads/').Content, 'DDNet-[0-9][0-9.]*-win64\.zip'); if (-not $m.Success) { throw 'Could not find the latest DDNet release' }; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ('https://ddnet.org/downloads/' + $m.Value) -OutFile ddnet.zip; tar.exe -xf ddnet.zip -C '{{$FullBaseDir}}' --strip-components=1 --exclude 'DDNet.exe' --exclude 'storage.cfg'; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Extracting the DDNet release failed' }; Remove-Item ddnet.zip; $m.Value + ' installed'"
